This repository produces `vis42.mcpb`, an MCP Bundle for Claude Desktop. It contains a Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy forwarding MCP operations to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. Spec: [MCPB MANIFEST.md](https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb/blob/main/MANIFEST.md).

The proxy must answer Claude Desktop's `initialize` immediately. Connect lazily on first request; never block in startup: `await connectToRemote(); // this will timeout Claude Desktop`

Transport **constructors never throw**. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. The SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call. Use:
`const transport = new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(url, { requestInit: { headers } });`
`await client.connect(transport);`
On failure, log `StreamableHTTP failed (${err.message}), retrying with SSE...`, then:
`const sseTransport = new SSEClientTransport(url, { requestInit: { headers } });`
`await client.connect(sseTransport); // let this throw naturally if SSE also fails`
Do not catch constructor errors.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel.
`const log = (msg) => process.stderr.write(\`[vis42-proxy] ${msg}\n\`);`
Never use `console.log("debug info");`.

Tools are stripped to `{ name, description }` only; runtime hints must not appear in the manifest. Prompts’ `arguments` are string names, not objects. `resources` is **not a valid manifest field**. The pack validator rejects it. Skip resources entirely for manifest; resources are handled at runtime by existing `resources/list`, `resources/read`, and `resources/templates/list` handlers.

The `toJSON()` expression in GitHub Actions produces `"null"` for absent fields. Use `const raw = JSON.parse(process.env.SOME_JSON || 'null') || [];` and `env:` variables for all payload data. Never interpolate `client_payload` fields directly in `run:` scripts:
`run: node -e "const data = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); ..."`
`DATA: ${{ toJSON(github.event.client_payload.tools) }}`

`manifest_version` is `"0.3"`; Do not change. `resources` — **Never**. `user_config.api_token` is injected as `VIS42_API_TOKEN`. Compatibility: `claude_desktop >= 0.10.0`, `node >= 18`, `darwin` + `win32`.

`manifest.json` → `.version` and `server/package.json` → `.version` must always have the same semver version. CI writes both atomically; when editing manually, update both.
